final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'h') THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'h') THEN m.molecule_id END), 2) as percentage FROM molecule m
